title: Note: worktree pool fixed and now heals itself

chat.text: Spawns and quick_fix work again: take_worktree hands out a slot and the six waiting minions were moved in. Cause: the pool forgot five worktrees that held work and could not mint a new name, and two dead holders kept their slots. Each sweep now salvages (never deletes) such worktrees, releases holders gone 12h+, and logs an ALERT when a spawn waits 10+ min. Details: Servex/doc/pool-stuck-2026-10-09.md. Also drafted .claude/skills/system-architect (outline only).
